actions.label: Mark the lines that ask for a decision

args.name: dry
args.label: Dry run
args.description: yes: say what it would write, and write nothing

rules.description: Asks the write review about a note an agent wrote, a minute after it was last saved, and marks what it finds

match.query: NOT type=annotation NOT type=annotation-reply NOT type=peer-message NOT type=draft-proposal NOT type=snapshot NOT type=virtual-branch NOT type=jev-run NOT type=review-finding NOT machine NOT demo NOT from NOT ext.page NOT asks=off NOT status=done NOT work-stage=done NOT work-stage=superseded NOT outbox=done

rules.description: Takes a mark off when its line is ticked, you reply under it, or the note reaches done
Takes a mark off when you comment on its line, or on the whole note
